functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bkhorguashvili.fiber_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'bkhorguashvili', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Audit history is append-only'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bkhorguashvili.fiber_assert_transition_node()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'bkhorguashvili', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "bkhorguashvili".fibers f JOIN "bkhorguashvili".cable_segments c
    ON c.network_revision=f.network_revision AND c.id=f.cable_id
    WHERE f.network_revision=NEW.network_revision AND f.id IN (NEW.fiber_a,NEW.fiber_z)
    AND NEW.node_id NOT IN (c.endpoint_a,c.endpoint_b)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fiber transition must share its real cable endpoint node'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bkhorguashvili.fiber_immutable_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'bkhorguashvili', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (SELECT status FROM "bkhorguashvili".network_revisions WHERE id=COALESCE(NEW.network_revision,OLD.network_revision))='validated'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Validated network snapshot is immutable'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
